# Vendored frontend dependencies

These files are committed so the local JobHunter interface remains usable when public CDNs are unavailable.

| File | Package | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lucide.min.js` | Lucide | 0.468.0 | https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.468.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js |
| `chart.umd.min.js` | Chart.js | 4.4.7 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.min.js |

Licenses are stored beside the bundles. When upgrading, replace the bundle and license together, update this table, and rerun the full browser matrix.
